comment_regular: MoonSugarEffect decode: NiGeometryGroup::AddGeometryDataToGroup. For hardware-skinned geometry, adds each partition object when the partition is compatible; for non-skinned geometry it only calls AddObject when BuffData is missing. Existing BuffData returns false, so this is packing/registration ownership rather than draw ownership.
